breakdown.description: project_metric only: group each bucket by this field, or 'metadata.<key>'. Not valid for every metric — schema('list.project_metric') says which.
breakdown.title: Breakdown

entity_type.description: One of: agent_insights_issue, experiment, online_rule, project, project_metric, prompt, prompt_version, score_name, span, test_suite, test_suite_item, thread, trace.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

filters.description: OQL filter for trace, span, thread, experiment, project_metric: <field>[.<key>] <op> <value> [AND ...]; ops = != > >= < <= contains not_contains starts_with ends_with is_empty is_not_empty in not_in; strings quoted, numbers bare (duration in ms). E.g. 'error_info is_not_empty AND duration > 5000', 'feedback_scores.accuracy < 0.5 AND start_time >= "2026-09-08T00:00:00Z"'. trace/span/thread default to source = "sdk"; a metric is filtered by the fields of the entity it is about. Reference: schema("list.trace").
filters.title: Filters

interval.description: project_metric only: bucket width. 'daily' by default.
interval.title: Interval

metric_type.description: project_metric only: which metric to chart. Reference: schema('list.project_metric').
metric_type.title: Metric Type

name.description: Optional substring filter on entity name. Supported for project, experiment, prompt, test_suite; ignored for sub-collections.
name.title: Name

project_id.description: Parent project UUID for project-scoped lists (trace, span, thread, agent_insights_issue). Pass this OR project_name.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Parent project name — alternative to project_id for project-scoped lists, so you don't need to resolve the UUID first.
project_name.title: Project Name

prompt_id.description: Required when listing prompt_versions. UUID of the prompt.
prompt_id.title: Prompt Id

search.description: Free text for trace, span, thread: matches anywhere in id, name, input, output, metadata, tags, thread_id (spans: model, provider too). Expensive on large projects; narrow with since first.
search.title: Search

series.description: project_metric only, with breakdown: which series to group — a percentile (p50/p90/p99), a score name, or a usage key.
series.title: Series

since.description: Start of the time window for trace, span, thread, project_metric, agent_insights_issue: a relative span ('30m', '1h', '24h', '7d') or an ISO-8601 instant with timezone. Trace/span/thread windows are by record creation time (for an exact start_time bound use filters); Diagnostics issues aggregate per report day, so their window is the UTC days it spans and defaults to all-time, matching the Diagnostics page.
since.title: Since

sort.description: Sort for trace, span, thread, experiment: '<field> [asc|desc]', desc by default. E.g. 'duration desc', 'total_estimated_cost', 'feedback_scores.accuracy asc', 'usage.total_tokens'. One field only.
sort.title: Sort

status.description: agent_insights_issue only: which Diagnostics issues to list. Defaults to 'open' (what is broken now); 'resolved' and 'closed' show issues already dealt with. Ignored for other entity types.
status.title: Status

test_suite_id.description: Required when listing test_suite_items. UUID of the suite.
test_suite_id.title: Test Suite Id

until.description: End of the time window, same forms as since.
until.title: Until
